outcome: effective dose at which 90% (ED90) of prophylactic norepinephrine infusion
finding: Crystalloid coloads of 5 mL/kg and 10 mL/kg significantly reduced the ED90 of prophylactic norepinephrine infusion needed to prevent post-spinal anesthesia hypotension during cesarean section by 11.9% and 25.0% respectively, compared to 0 mL/kg.
mod_finding: Crystalloid coload volumes influenced the effective dose of norepinephrine needed to prevent hypotension during cesarean section.
